metadata.title: Safe Work at the Lathe
metadata.description: Protective equipment, chuck key rules and what to do when chips wrap around the workpiece.

resource.content: Safety glasses and close-fitting clothing. No gloves near rotating parts: they can be caught and pull the hand in.
Never leave the chuck key in the chuck. Check that the workpiece is clamped and the guard is closed.
Stop the machine before removing chips. Use a chip hook, never your hands.

question.text: Why are gloves forbidden near rotating parts?
question.option: They can be caught and pull the hand in

question.text: Where does the chuck key belong when the machine starts?
How do you remove wrapped chips?
question.option: Machine stopped, with a chip hook
